Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/PROJECT_RULES.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW.md`, `docs/base/ENGINEERING_CONSTITUTION.md`, and relevant registries before proposing or implementing changes.

This repository follows:
- Angular standalone components
- feature-first structure
- shared reuse before creation
- full responsive behavior
- theme support
- language support
- technical docs in English
- user-facing help translated by supported application languages

Do not create new shared UI, helpers, API services, or patterns without checking existing assets first.
